primary_endpoint: Percentage of participants with NASH resolution without worsening of fibrosis after 72 weeks.
efficacy_outcome: Reported percentages were 40.4%, 35.6%, and 58.9% for semaglutide 0.1, 0.2, and 0.4 mg, respectively, versus 17.2% for placebo; additional percentages are listed without group labels. Statistical significance is not stated.
safety_signal: Serious adverse events: 12/80, 15/78, and 12/81 participants in the semaglutide groups, respectively, versus 8/80 with placebo. One death was reported in the 0.2 mg group; none in the other groups.
